method.ci: t95 for unpaired summaries; exact 5^5 percentile bootstrap for paired means
method.threshold: each seed's own scratch@10M validation loss; first linear crossing; no extrapolation
method.auc: trapezoidal integral over actual tokens, divided by 1e6; interpolated common start
method.perplexity: mean of logged per-seed perplexities, not exp(mean loss)
